fusions.name: Unseen Nip
fusions.desc: Throws a sliver that deals 7 damage, with 50% more critical chance on a target that has not been wounded. It holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gnawed Gate
fusions.desc: Sets a barrier of bars 4 tiles long for 6 seconds that blocks the way, dealing 12 damage to enemies it touches and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hush Behind Bars
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Burrowed Hours
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
